description: Vendor-neutral provenance classes for effect evidence (specification section 22.14). `provider_generated` distinguishes downstream-system evidence from adapter observations.

entries.description: Synchronous response of the core banking system to the executed operation.
Status retrieved from or pushed by the payment hub for a submitted instruction or batch.
Synchronous response of a lending platform.
A read of the authoritative ledger after the write.
An acknowledgement or status from a payment network or clearing system.
A cryptographically signed event delivered by the downstream system.
An observation made by the banking adapter itself, distinct from provider evidence.
A recorded human attestation of the observed effect.
